business.name: Kit Self Test
business.description: This site exists so the toolchain has something real to run against. It is generated from the template by the self-test, which is what keeps the template honest: if generation breaks, the kit's own verification fails.

hero.headline: A single-page application that answer engines can still read.
hero.subhead: Generated from the template so every tool in this kit has a real target, and so a broken template fails the kit's own verification rather than a client's site.

sections.label: Render
sections.title: Server-rendered by default
sections.body: As of 2026 the AI crawlers fetch raw HTML and never execute JavaScript, so a client-rendered page reaches them as an empty shell. Navigation still feels like a single-page application, but every route answers with complete markup.

sections.label: Oracles
sections.title: Three independent checks
sections.body: A crawler probe with no JavaScript engine, a blind breaker that sees only the contract and a live URL, and a browser suite covering visuals, accessibility, motion and performance budgets. Each one can fail the build on its own.

sections.label: Motion
sections.title: Tokens, not literals
sections.body: Durations and easing curves come from the design tokens, which is what lets reduced motion collapse every animation to zero and lets a screenshot baseline freeze them without hunting through components for hard-coded values.
